policy.promotion_rule: Promote only if shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs, out of sample, without worse drawdown.

gates.name: Disagreement P&L
gates.target: Shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs.
gates.progress: 7504 disagreement observations logged; 459 tracked shadow recommendations and 18 tracked live recommendations.

gates.name: Backtest Windows
gates.target: Shadow beats active over 3, 6, and 12 month windows.
gates.progress: 3 month: insufficient data, 6 month: insufficient data, 12 month: insufficient data

gates.name: Calibration
gates.target: Brier score improves or stays close while P&L improves.

gates.name: Risk Shape
gates.target: Sharpe is no worse and drawdown does not materially increase.
gates.progress: 3 month: insufficient data, 6 month: insufficient data, 12 month: insufficient data

gates.name: Coverage
gates.target: Option-chain coverage remains stable and representative.

policy.costs: bid/ask spread is included; gross mid-to-mid P&L and spread cost are also reported
policy.sharpe: annualized from daily lane returns using sqrt(252), zero risk-free rate
policy.drawdown: peak-to-trough drawdown of compounded daily lane returns
policy.dependence_control: promotion must also pass after collapsing repeated intraday scans to one daily lane/contract exposure
policy.absolute_profitability: the cluster-adjusted challenger return must be positive, not merely less negative than active
policy.uncertainty: paired market-day return lift must have a positive 95% nonparametric bootstrap lower bound and at least 95% bootstrap probability of improvement

policy.label: strict Friday-close executable outcome v2 or newer
policy.candidate_pairing: active and challenger score the same post-friction recommendation; friction vetoes remain ineligible
policy.missing_outcomes: rank replay excludes a run unless every scored candidate is resolved

rank_replay.selection_policy: top one active-payoff versus challenger probability per run from the identical fully resolved, post-friction candidate set

model_cohort.policy: analyze only the latest observed challenger artifact; never pool model versions

policy.missing_outcomes: rank replay excludes a run unless every scored candidate is resolved

rank_replay.selection_policy: top one active-payoff versus challenger probability per run from the identical fully resolved, post-friction candidate set

model_cohort.policy: analyze only the latest observed challenger artifact; never pool model versions
